sections.headingEn: ASDU metadata is not a point name
paragraphsEn: Type identification describes object representation; VSQ indicates object count and sequential addressing structure; COT explains the purpose of transmission; Common Address scopes a station; the information object identifies a point under the selected protocol. A project mapping table supplies friendly signal names and engineering units.

An SQ=1 sequence may imply consecutive addresses for subsequent objects; SQ=0 includes addressing with individual objects as defined by the type. Misinterpreting VSQ or field widths can make hundreds of valid points appear missing or attached to the wrong station.
paragraphsId: Type ID menjelaskan representasi objek; VSQ menunjukkan jumlah serta susunan alamat objek; COT menunjukkan alasan pengiriman; Common Address menentukan cakupan stasiun; objek informasi mengidentifikasi point menurut protokol. Tabel mapping proyek memberi nama sinyal dan unit engineering.
SQ=1 dapat berarti alamat objek lanjutan berurutan; SQ=0 menyertakan alamat per objek sesuai tipenya. VSQ atau panjang field yang salah membuat banyak point valid tampak hilang atau salah stasiun.
bulletsEn: Decode every object, not just the first in a multi-object ASDU.
Do not transform GI snapshots into spontaneous SOE by string matching.
Preserve raw signed, scaled, normalized or floating representation before applying project engineering range.
bulletsId: Decode setiap objek, bukan hanya objek pertama ASDU multi-object.
Jangan mengubah snapshot GI menjadi SOE spontan melalui pencocokan teks.
Simpan representasi raw signed, scaled, normalized atau floating sebelum konversi range engineering.

sections.headingEn: Quality and overflow are separate dimensions
sections.headingId: Quality dan overflow adalah dimensi berbeda
paragraphsEn: A status or measurement can carry protocol quality bits. QDS overflow does not mean IEC 101 event queue overflow, BCR carry, link DFC or UART serial overrun. Preserve the original flag even when a numeric value looks plausible.
Time tags should be retained with their validity semantics, and event time distinguished from PC receive time. Do not replace invalid or missing quality with an optimistic Good flag.
paragraphsId: Status atau measurement dapat membawa bit quality. QDS overflow tidak sama dengan overflow antrian event IEC 101, BCR carry, DFC link atau UART serial overrun. Pertahankan flag asli meskipun angka terlihat masuk akal.
Time tag harus disimpan beserta validitasnya, dan waktu event dibedakan dari waktu RX komputer. Jangan mengganti quality yang invalid/hilang dengan Good hanya karena nilai terlihat benar.
bulletsEn: QDS OV, IV, NT, SB, BL and other flags require typed interpretation for the applicable object.
A numeric wraparound is not proof of QDS OV or a gateway bug.
If quality cannot be decoded, show Unknown with original bytes.
bulletsId: QDS OV, IV, NT, SB, BL dan flag lain harus ditafsirkan menurut tipe objek yang benar.
Nilai numerik wraparound bukan bukti QDS OV atau bug gateway.
Jika quality tidak dapat di-decode, tampilkan Unknown beserta byte asli.

paragraphsEn: Distinguish (1) request transmitted, (2) link/APCI acknowledged, (3) application ACTCON/ACTTERM or negative completion, and (4) fresh process-state feedback proving the intended change. Select-before-operate and direct operate are alternative procedures selected by the device and project profile, not interchangeable guesses.

A missing response may mean unobserved frames, link loss, rejection or ambiguous execution. An engineer should not automatically retry a real breaker control until actual device state and permission are re-established.
paragraphsId: Bedakan (1) request dikirim, (2) link/APCI diakui, (3) ACTCON/ACTTERM aplikasi atau penyelesaian negatif, dan (4) feedback state proses baru yang membuktikan perubahan. Select-before-operate dan direct operate adalah prosedur alternatif sesuai perangkat/profil proyek, bukan tebakan yang bisa ditukar.

Respons yang hilang dapat berarti frame tidak teramati, link putus, penolakan atau eksekusi ambigu. Engineer tidak boleh otomatis mengulang kontrol breaker fisik sebelum kondisi perangkat dan izin kembali terverifikasi.
bulletsEn: Use source-scoped command IDs and do not correlate unrelated confirmations after failover.
Verify interlock/authorization separately from protocol delivery.
Only a fresh mapped feedback state can support a field-operation conclusion.
bulletsId: Gunakan ID command per sumber dan jangan mencocokkan confirmation tidak terkait setelah failover.
Verifikasi interlock/otorisasi terpisah dari delivery protokol.
Hanya feedback mapped yang baru dapat mendukung kesimpulan operasi lapangan.

sections.headingEn: ASDU reading exercise: stop at the right layer
sections.headingId: Latihan membaca ASDU: berhenti pada layer yang tepat
paragraphsEn: Given a valid IEC 104 I-frame containing a measured value, read transport/APCI state first, then Type ID, VSQ, COT, Common Address and each object's IOA, encoded value and quality. Apply project scaling only after validating the encoding. If the target CA differs from the configured station, preserve the observed value but do not silently attach it to another point.
A negative activation confirmation answers a command-lifecycle question, not a measurement-quality question. A QDS overflow flag belongs to its information object, not the event queue or TCP state.
paragraphsId: Pada I-frame IEC 104 valid yang membawa analog, baca dulu status transport/APCI, lalu Type ID, VSQ, COT, Common Address dan IOA tiap objek, nilai encoded serta quality. Terapkan scaling proyek sesudah validasi encoding. Bila CA berbeda dari stasiun yang dikonfigurasi, simpan nilai teramati tetapi jangan diam-diam memindahkannya ke point lain.
Negative activation confirmation menjawab pertanyaan siklus command, bukan kualitas pengukuran. Flag QDS overflow milik objek informasinya, bukan antrian event atau status TCP.
bulletsEn: Differentiate Type ID identification from project point naming.
Retain raw numeric representation, engineering range and quality independently.
Report each unsupported field as unknown with trace proof, not as an invented zero.
bulletsId: Bedakan identitas Type ID dari nama point proyek.
Pertahankan representasi angka mentah, range engineering dan quality secara independen.
Laporkan field tidak didukung sebagai unknown dengan bukti trace, bukan nol yang dikarang.

chapters.summaryId: Pahami batas konversi, mapping CA/IOA dan timestamp sumber.

sections.headingEn: The RTU can be a translator
paragraphsEn: An IEC gateway can collect IEC 103 relay events, IEC 61850 data, Modbus register values or hardwired I/O and expose them as IEC 101/104 information objects. The gateway owns the outward-point representation and may generate new quality and time semantics.

Prove two separate edges: source acquisition and IEC outward transmission. A changing source does not prove that an outgoing spontaneous ASDU was sent, and a successful GI after manual refresh does not prove that event reporting works continuously.
paragraphsId: Gateway IEC dapat mengumpulkan event relay IEC 103, data IEC 61850, register Modbus atau hardwired I/O dan mengeksposnya sebagai objek IEC 101/104. Gateway memiliki representasi point keluar dan dapat menghasilkan quality serta waktu baru.

Buktikan dua sisi terpisah: akuisisi sumber dan pengiriman IEC keluar. Sumber yang berubah belum membuktikan ASDU spontan telah dikirim, dan GI sukses sesudah refresh manual tidak membuktikan event reporting selalu bekerja.
bulletsEn: Record source signal, gateway conversion and target CA/IOA independently.
Do not infer source quality from a synthetic gateway Good flag.
Keep gateway buffering and event suppression policy visible.
bulletsId: Catat sinyal sumber, konversi gateway dan CA/IOA tujuan secara independen.
Jangan menyimpulkan quality sumber dari Good yang dibentuk gateway.
Tampilkan kebijakan buffer dan suppression event gateway.

paragraphsEn: Raw scaled values, normalized values and IEEE floating-point values represent measurements differently. The SCADA point list defines engineering ranges and units. Decode signedness and raw representation before applying user scaling; a wrapped or saturated value is not proof of one particular vendor defect.
Retain quality-overflow flags independently of the numeric reading. Measurement OV, BCR carry, queue overflow and link DFC describe different layers.
paragraphsId: Raw scaled, normalized dan IEEE floating-point mewakili analog secara berbeda. Point list SCADA menentukan range engineering dan unit. Decode signedness serta representasi raw sebelum menerapkan scaling; nilai yang wrap atau saturasi bukan bukti satu bug vendor tertentu.
Simpan flag overflow quality terpisah dari angka bacaan. Measurement OV, BCR carry, queue overflow dan DFC link menjelaskan layer berbeda.
bulletsEn: Check type-specific representation before reporting numerical anomalies.
A point name cannot be guessed from its IOA without the project mapping sheet.
bulletsId: Periksa representasi sesuai tipe sebelum melaporkan anomali angka.
Nama point tidak boleh ditebak dari IOA tanpa mapping proyek.

paragraphsEn: Capture the actual field change and source event, then the gateway ingestion, mapping to an outgoing point, event queue, selected COT, transmission and master receipt. Missing any one step prevents claiming the downstream SCADA should already have updated.

A manual read or GI can fill a value without exercising the spontaneous event path. Test deliberate safe state changes in a simulator or an approved non-operational test point; do not drive live breaker controls merely to generate documentation evidence.
paragraphsId: Capture perubahan lapangan dan event sumber, lalu ingestion gateway, mapping ke point keluar, antrian event, COT terpilih, TX dan penerimaan master. Langkah yang belum terbukti membuat kesimpulan SCADA hilir seharusnya sudah update tidak cukup kuat.

Read manual atau GI dapat mengisi value tanpa melewati jalur event spontan. Uji perubahan aman pada simulator atau test point non-operasional yang disetujui; jangan mengoperasikan breaker hidup hanya untuk membuat evidence dokumentasi.

framesId: SUMBER -> input gateway -> mapping -> antrian/COT -> TX ASDU IEC -> RX master

chapters.summaryEn: An opt-in interoperability convention—not a universal IEC requirement.
chapters.summaryId: Konvensi interoperabilitas yang dipilih khusus—bukan kewajiban universal IEC.
chapters.searchText: norwegian user convention nuc 101 104 redundancy primary standby switch serial

paragraphsEn: NUC means Norwegian User Conventions: project/industry interoperability conventions layered on selected IEC 60870-5 companion-standard options. Historical references include IEC 101 rev 2.0 (24 March 2000) and IEC 104 rev 1.2 (4 February 2000). A device may be IEC 101 compliant without implementing the selected NUC revision.

Only an approved controlled NUC document plus the project's interoperability list can establish required field lengths, class mapping, supported Type IDs and optional behavior. A third-party transcription is not a safe source for certification claims.
paragraphsId: NUC adalah Norwegian User Conventions: konvensi interoperabilitas proyek/industri di atas opsi companion standard IEC 60870-5. Rujukan historis antara lain NUC 101 revisi 2.0 (24 Maret 2000) dan NUC 104 revisi 1.2 (4 Februari 2000). Perangkat dapat memenuhi IEC 101 tanpa menerapkan revisi NUC tertentu.

Hanya dokumen NUC terkendali yang disetujui serta interoperability list proyek yang dapat menetapkan panjang field, class mapping, Type ID dan perilaku opsional. Transkripsi pihak ketiga tidak cukup untuk klaim sertifikasi.
bulletsEn: Treat NUC as an explicit versioned profile; do not silently enable it for every RTU.
Keep project deviations and overrides in a signed compatibility list.
Do not confuse a NUC deployment prescription with mandatory IEC behavior.
bulletsId: Jadikan NUC sebagai profil eksplisit dan berversi; jangan mengaktifkannya untuk semua RTU tanpa pilihan.
Catat deviasi dan override proyek dalam daftar kompatibilitas yang disetujui.
Jangan menyamakan ketentuan deployment NUC dengan aturan IEC yang wajib untuk semua perangkat.

sections.headingEn: NUC 101 polling, buffering and serial switch
sections.headingId: NUC 101: polling, buffer dan pergantian link
paragraphsEn: NUC-style unbalanced redundant serial operation can supervise both links while performing application traffic on the selected primary. The standby is not an independent Class 1/Class 2 event drain under that selected policy; moving application ownership requires link state initialization and careful FCB/acknowledgment continuity.

The historical NUC101 reference does not universally require a full GI immediately after serial switchover. The controlling station may elect a GI as a project-specific freshness policy. An event queue overflow indication, if mapped, must not be confused with measurement QDS OV, BCR carry, DFC or local capture overrun.
paragraphsId: Operasi redundant serial unbalanced bergaya NUC dapat mengawasi kedua link sambil menjalankan traffic aplikasi hanya pada primary terpilih. Standby bukan drain event Class 1/Class 2 independen dalam kebijakan itu; perpindahan ownership memerlukan inisialisasi state link serta kesinambungan FCB/ACK yang hati-hati.

Referensi historis NUC101 tidak mewajibkan GI penuh secara universal segera setelah serial switchover. Controlling station boleh memilih GI sebagai kebijakan freshness khusus proyek. Indikasi overflow antrian event, bila dimapping, tidak sama dengan QDS OV, BCR carry, DFC atau overrun capture lokal.
bulletsEn: Standby status/link-health probes must not be mistaken for application ownership.
Record the exact last confirmed event before and after switching.
Make the post-switch GI policy explicit: required by project, optional, or disabled with stale-image warning.
bulletsId: Probe status/kesehatan link standby tidak boleh dianggap sebagai ownership aplikasi.
Catat event terakhir yang terkonfirmasi sebelum dan sesudah switch.
Nyatakan kebijakan GI pasca-switch: wajib proyek, opsional, atau nonaktif dengan peringatan image stale.

paragraphsEn: Some Norwegian 104 deployment specifications define multiple possible frontends but only one active logical connection at a time; the new active frontend initiates STARTDT while the passive channels remain supervised. This must not be projected onto every IEC 104 server.
A railway-specific Norwegian procurement specification describes frontend-change GI behavior for its system. It does not establish a universal IEC 101 serial line switchover rule.
paragraphsId: Beberapa spesifikasi deployment 104 di Norwegia menjelaskan beberapa frontend yang mungkin terhubung tetapi hanya satu koneksi logis aktif. Frontend baru menginisiasi STARTDT sementara channel pasif diawasi. Pola ini tidak boleh digeneralisasikan untuk setiap server IEC 104.
Spesifikasi pengadaan kereta Norwegia mengatur GI setelah frontend berubah untuk sistemnya. Hal tersebut bukan aturan universal pergantian saluran serial IEC 101.
bulletsEn: Compare the adopted NUC revision, specific RTU profile and owner-of-control rule.
Treat IEC 101 redundancy and IEC 104 frontend takeovers as separate state machines.
bulletsId: Bandingkan revisi NUC, profil RTU spesifik dan aturan pemilik kontrol.
Perlakukan redundansi IEC 101 dan takeover frontend IEC 104 sebagai state machine terpisah.

paragraphsEn: Record the exact revision of the Norwegian convention, the IEC companion standard edition and the negotiated deviations. Never assume that a configuration called 'NUC' automatically defines every transmission field length or supported command. The approved project interoperability list is the binding selection of permitted options.

For NUC-style serial A/B redundancy, verify whether standby is status-supervised and whether a full GI after switching is an explicit project choice. For IEC 104 multiconnection behavior, verify how frontend authorization and STARTDT are controlled. These are separate system contracts.
paragraphsId: Catat revisi konvensi Norwegia, edisi companion standard IEC dan deviasi yang disepakati. Jangan mengasumsikan nama konfigurasi 'NUC' otomatis menentukan semua panjang field atau command. Interoperability list proyek yang disetujui merupakan pilihan opsi yang mengikat.

Untuk redundansi serial A/B bergaya NUC, verifikasi apakah standby diawasi melalui status serta apakah GI penuh setelah switch merupakan keputusan proyek. Untuk IEC 104 multikoneksi, verifikasi bagaimana kewenangan frontend dan STARTDT dikontrol. Keduanya kontrak sistem yang berbeda.
bulletsEn: Agree companion edition + convention revision + vendor interoperability options.
For each physical channel, record link address, FCB and acknowledgment evidence.
For controls, define retry and failover handling of ambiguous execution.
bulletsId: Sepakati edisi companion + revisi konvensi + opsi interoperabilitas vendor.
Untuk tiap kanal fisik, catat link address, FCB dan evidence ACK.
Untuk kontrol, tetapkan retry dan penanganan eksekusi ambigu saat failover.

chapters.summaryId: Link A/B, aktif/standby, ownership, evidence failover dan pengaman pemulihan.

sections.headingEn: Redundancy is not simply two cables
paragraphsEn: Redundancy provides alternative communication routes to keep station information and control available after one route fails. The design must state who owns application polls, event acknowledgments, GI and controls; a physically connected standby link need not carry normal process traffic.

The two links can have independent physical state, link-layer counters, fault timers and recovery history. Mirroring one live FCB/sequence state into two independently established channels risks duplicates, loss and incorrect acknowledgments.
paragraphsId: Redundansi menyediakan jalur komunikasi alternatif agar informasi dan kontrol stasiun tetap tersedia saat satu jalur gagal. Desain harus menyatakan siapa pemilik polling aplikasi, ACK event, GI dan kontrol; link standby yang terhubung secara fisik tidak harus membawa traffic proses normal.

Kedua link dapat memiliki state fisik, counter link, timer fault serta riwayat pemulihan masing-masing. Menyalin satu state FCB/sequence ke dua channel independen berisiko duplikat, kehilangan data dan ACK keliru.
bulletsEn: Active/hot: carries approved process traffic and owns command/event transactions.
Standby/healthy: supervised using protocol-appropriate status/liveness, not automatically the same application scan.
Failover: detect, verify viable standby, demote old owner, initialize promoted link/session, restore process image as policy specifies.
bulletsId: Active/hot: membawa traffic proses yang disetujui dan memiliki transaksi command/event.
Standby/sehat: diawasi melalui status/liveness sesuai protokol, bukan otomatis scan aplikasi yang sama.
Failover: deteksi, validasi standby layak, turunkan owner lama, inisialisasi link/session baru, perbarui process image sesuai kebijakan.

paragraphsEn: Example only for the selected unbalanced active/standby profile: master initially polls Class 2 and drains Class 1 on A; B receives bounded link-status supervision. After A fails and B is proven healthy, master stops sending controls on A, initializes the B link state, and begins polling B. It decides whether to perform post-switch GI based on the approved interoperability profile.

A well-behaved RTU should avoid claiming independent completion for the same ambiguous control on both links. Event buffering, retransmission and duplicate handling need source-scoped confirmation. If the RTU supports a shared event queue, verify its exact acknowledgment behavior rather than assuming perfect cross-link continuity.
paragraphsId: Contoh hanya untuk profil unbalanced active/standby terpilih: master awalnya polling Class 2 dan drain Class 1 pada A; B menerima supervisi status link terbatas. Setelah A gagal dan B terbukti sehat, master berhenti mengirim kontrol di A, menginisialisasi state link B, lalu mulai polling di B. GI pasca-switch dipilih berdasarkan profil interoperabilitas yang disetujui.

RTU yang dirancang baik tidak boleh mengklaim dua penyelesaian independen untuk kontrol ambigu yang sama di dua link. Buffer event, retransmit dan duplikasi memerlukan konfirmasi sesuai sumber. Bila RTU mempunyai antrian event bersama, uji perilaku ACK-nya; jangan menganggap kontinuitas lintas link pasti sempurna.
bulletsEn: A active: Class 2 / bounded Class 1 / GI / command; B standby: link-status only (if profile allows).
Failure A: stop ownership of A; do not auto-repeat uncertain commands.
Promote B: initialize/reset link as selected; verify fresh responses and optional policy GI.
Recover A: hold as standby until sustained good health; avoid immediate failback ping-pong.
bulletsId: A aktif: Class 2 / Class 1 terbatas / GI / command; B standby: status link saja (jika profil mengizinkan).
A gagal: hentikan ownership A; jangan otomatis mengulang command ambigu.
Promosi B: inisialisasi/reset link sesuai profil; pastikan respons baru dan GI menurut kebijakan.
A pulih: tahan sebagai standby sampai kesehatan stabil; hindari ping-pong failback.
framesEn: A: TX Class 2 ← RX status/data; B: TX status ← RX link health
A times out → B validation → B init → B starts Class 2
Switch proof: owner A→B, first valid RX on B, last confirmed event
framesId: A: TX Class 2 ← RX status/data; B: TX status ← RX kesehatan link
A timeout → B tervalidasi → B init → B mulai Class 2
Bukti switch: owner A→B, RX valid pertama B, event terakhir terkonfirmasi

paragraphsEn: In IEC 104 redundancy, keep TCP socket state, APCI N(S)/N(R), STARTDT authority and received application identity separate for every frontend connection. A new socket may be connected but should not be declared application-active until its permitted STARTDT handshake completes.

Where a deployment enforces single-active semantics, terminate or stop old application ownership before promoting the new channel. TESTFR/keepalive on a standby socket tests liveness, not permission to send duplicate process data. Some other interoperable profiles support different multi-connection behavior; use the system-specific agreement.
paragraphsId: Untuk redundansi IEC 104, pisahkan state socket TCP, APCI N(S)/N(R), kewenangan STARTDT dan identitas aplikasi untuk tiap frontend. Socket baru mungkin sudah connected tetapi belum aktif untuk aplikasi sebelum handshake STARTDT yang diizinkan selesai.

Jika deployment mewajibkan satu channel aktif, hentikan ownership aplikasi lama sebelum mempromosikan channel baru. TESTFR/keepalive pada standby hanya menguji liveness, bukan izin mengirim data proses duplikat. Profil lain dapat mempunyai perilaku multi-connection berbeda; ikuti agreement sistem.
bulletsEn: New TCP session has its own APCI sequence context; do not copy N(S)/N(R) from the old link.
Promoted frontend STARTDT and image refresh are distinct confirmations.
Reconcile stale snapshot vs missed event history in the report; neither is automatically a physical process change.
bulletsId: Session TCP baru punya konteks sequence APCI sendiri; jangan menyalin N(S)/N(R) dari link lama.
STARTDT frontend yang dipromosikan dan refresh image adalah konfirmasi berbeda.
Rekonsiliasi snapshot stale dengan event history yang terlewat dalam laporan; keduanya bukan otomatis perubahan fisik proses.

paragraphsEn: Test controlled A→B and B→A transitions, loss of active only, loss of standby only, intermittent recovery, power restart and ambiguous command in flight. Evidence must show why the controller promoted a link and when the new application image became trustworthy.

Safety-conscious failback is often manual or guarded by a stability interval to prevent oscillation. Failover success cannot be concluded solely from a green connection badge; verify the first application response, spontaneous event continuity and permitted commands.
paragraphsId: Uji transisi A→B dan B→A, hilangnya active saja, hilangnya standby saja, pemulihan intermiten, restart daya serta command ambigu saat proses switch. Evidence harus menunjukkan alasan promosi link dan kapan application image kembali dipercaya.

Failback yang aman sering manual atau dikawal interval stabilitas agar tidak berosilasi. Sukses failover tidak cukup disimpulkan dari badge koneksi hijau; verifikasi respons aplikasi pertama, kontinuitas event spontan dan command yang diizinkan.
bulletsEn: Record active owner, trigger, threshold, last confirmed frame and first new link frame.
Simulate a queued event at switch boundary; prove no silent loss or duplicate accepted as new fact.
Simulate an in-flight control; prove no duplicate actuation on either link.
Test frozen/stale Values until fresh GI/verified data and explicit recovery/failback rules.
bulletsId: Catat owner aktif, pemicu, threshold, frame terakhir terkonfirmasi dan frame pertama pada link baru.
Simulasikan event saat pergantian; buktikan tidak ada kehilangan diam-diam atau duplikat dianggap event baru.
Simulasikan kontrol saat in-flight; buktikan tidak terjadi aktuasi ganda di kedua link.
Uji Values stale/frozen sampai GI/data valid baru dan aturan recovery/failback eksplisit.

paragraphsEn: Two controllers that independently believe they own an outstation may duplicate GI, event drains or process commands. A robust active/standby design establishes an explicit owner and evidence of authority transfer. A connected standby interface and a valid link response are not by themselves proof of application ownership.

For a changeover under uncertain connectivity, block ambiguous in-flight commands, fence the old owner when supported and verify one new owner by transaction trace before re-enabling controls. Exact fencing and event-queue mechanisms vary by vendor and approved protocol profile.
paragraphsId: Dua controller yang sama-sama menganggap diri pemilik outstation dapat menggandakan GI, drain event atau command. Desain active/standby yang baik menetapkan owner eksplisit beserta evidence perpindahan kewenangan. Interface standby yang tersambung dan respons link valid belum membuktikan ownership aplikasi.

Saat pergantian dalam kondisi komunikasi tidak pasti, blokir command ambigu yang masih berjalan, batasi owner lama bila didukung dan verifikasi satu owner baru melalui trace transaksi sebelum mengizinkan kontrol lagi. Mekanisme fencing dan antrian event bergantung vendor serta profil protokol yang disetujui.
bulletsEn: Record the controller identity and application ownership epoch in each transaction.
Prove healthy standby first, then promote; avoid declaring failover from a GUI color alone.
Confirm stale/fresh application image after takeover, separately from physical device availability.
bulletsId: Catat identitas controller dan epoch ownership aplikasi pada setiap transaksi.
Buktikan standby sehat dahulu lalu promosikan; jangan menyimpulkan failover hanya dari warna GUI.
Pastikan application image stale/fresh setelah takeover, terpisah dari ketersediaan fisik perangkat.

sections.headingId: Batas switch: apa yang tidak lagi terbukti?
paragraphsEn: A switchover can occur after a command was sent but before application confirmation or feedback was captured. Treat the outcome as unknown until source-side status is re-read and control authority restored. Likewise a returned event after switch may be a buffered retransmission rather than a new process transition.

Use a test matrix that forces failure at several points: before TX, after TX but before confirmation, after confirmation before feedback, and during event queue draining. The expected behavior is safe ownership and explicit uncertainty, not magic exactly-once guarantees across arbitrary vendor implementations.
paragraphsId: Switchover bisa terjadi sesudah command dikirim tetapi sebelum konfirmasi aplikasi atau feedback tercapture. Perlakukan hasilnya sebagai unknown sampai status dari sumber dibaca ulang dan otoritas kontrol kembali terverifikasi. Event yang datang setelah switch bisa berupa retransmit buffer, bukan transisi proses baru.

Gunakan matriks tes yang memaksa gangguan pada beberapa titik: sebelum TX, sesudah TX sebelum konfirmasi, sesudah konfirmasi sebelum feedback, serta saat drain antrian event. Hasil yang diharapkan adalah ownership aman dan ketidakpastian eksplisit, bukan jaminan exactly-once otomatis semua implementasi vendor.
bulletsEn: Keep last confirmed event and first confirmed new-link frame in failover evidence.
Correlate event deduplication by source, event identity and time only when such identity is verifiable.
Require explicit operator review for ambiguous physical control execution.
bulletsId: Simpan event terakhir terkonfirmasi dan frame valid pertama pada link baru sebagai evidence failover.
Korelasikan duplikasi event menurut sumber, identitas dan waktu hanya jika identitas tersebut dapat diverifikasi.
Wajibkan peninjauan operator untuk hasil eksekusi kontrol fisik yang ambigu.

sections.headingEn: IEC101 A/B standby is not a duplicate polling master
sections.headingId: Standby IEC101 A/B bukan master polling duplikat
paragraphsEn: Consider a selected unbalanced active/standby arrangement: master sends Class 2 and bounded Class 1 requests to active link A, while link B receives only profile-permitted link-status supervision. An independent B Class 1 event drain is not implied by having two cables.
When A fails, choose B only after its health is proved, initialize B's independent link state and apply the explicitly approved post-switch GI policy.
paragraphsId: Pada konfigurasi unbalanced active/standby yang dipilih: master mengirim Class 2 dan Class 1 terbatas pada link aktif A, sedangkan B hanya mendapat supervisi link-status yang diizinkan profil. Adanya dua kabel tidak berarti B juga melakukan drain Class 1 sendiri.
Ketika A gagal, pilih B setelah kesehatannya terbukti, inisialisasi state link B yang independen dan terapkan kebijakan GI pasca-switch yang disetujui eksplisit.
bulletsEn: Capture primary/secondary direction separately for A and B.
No automatic global mandate for full GI after serial switchover.
bulletsId: Capture arah primary/secondary terpisah untuk A dan B.
Tidak ada kewajiban GI penuh universal setelah switchover serial.
framesEn: A active: Class2 + bounded Class1 | B: link-status supervision only
A fails -> prove B healthy -> reset/init B -> start approved traffic
framesId: A aktif: Class2 + Class1 terbatas | B: hanya supervisi link-status
A gagal -> buktikan B sehat -> reset/init B -> mulai traffic sesuai persetujuan

lab.scenarioEn: A is polling Class 2; B periodically receives primary FC9 link-status requests.
lab.scenarioId: A melakukan polling Class 2; B secara periodik mendapat request link-status primary FC9.
stepsEn: Status probes prove standby link liveness only.
Expect event drains and controls on the selected active owner.
stepsId: Probe status hanya membuktikan liveness standby.
Drain event dan kontrol diharapkan pada owner aktif terpilih.
lab.questionEn: Is link B defective because it receives no Class 1 polling?
lab.questionId: Apakah link B rusak karena tidak menerima polling Class 1?
lab.answerEn: No. In this selected active/standby profile that is normal standby behavior. Diagnose against the approved contract, not a copied active scan.
lab.answerId: Tidak. Pada profil active/standby ini perilaku standby normal. Diagnosa berdasarkan kontrak yang disetujui, bukan salinan scan aktif.

sections.headingEn: IEC104 frontend takeover needs new APCI state
sections.headingId: Takeover frontend IEC104 membutuhkan state APCI baru
paragraphsEn: Some selected IEC104 redundancy policies require one application-active frontend among several TCP connections. A connected standby does not have the same STARTDT authority as the current owner.

When a new frontend becomes active, perform its own approved STARTDT exchange, establish independent N(S)/N(R), and refresh image data according to the project's GI policy. Never copy sequence numbers from the old socket.
paragraphsId: Sebagian kebijakan redundansi IEC104 yang dipilih mengharuskan satu frontend aktif aplikasi di antara beberapa koneksi TCP. Standby yang tersambung belum memiliki kewenangan STARTDT seperti owner kini.

Saat frontend baru menjadi aktif, jalankan STARTDT yang disetujui pada koneksinya sendiri, bangun N(S)/N(R) independen, dan segarkan image sesuai kebijakan GI proyek. Jangan menyalin sequence socket lama.
bulletsEn: Distinguish TCP connected, STARTDT confirmed, new process image complete.
Prevent both owners from issuing ambiguous duplicate commands.
bulletsId: Bedakan TCP tersambung, STARTDT terkonfirmasi, image proses baru lengkap.
Cegah dua owner mengirim command duplikat ambigu.

lab.scenarioEn: Standby frontend B begins its permitted active transfer after A has been demoted.
lab.scenarioId: Frontend standby B memulai transfer aktif yang diizinkan setelah A diturunkan.
stepsEn: New TCP B association has its own APCI state.
The U-frame requests activation but does not prove it was confirmed.
stepsId: Asosiasi TCP B baru memiliki state APCI sendiri.
U-frame meminta aktivasi tetapi belum membuktikan konfirmasi.
lab.questionEn: Can N(S) from old frontend A be reused unchanged on B?
lab.questionId: Bolehkah N(S) dari frontend A lama dipakai begitu saja pada B?
lab.answerEn: No. IEC104 sequence accounting is per TCP association. Use the new session's independently validated state.
lab.answerId: Tidak. Akuntansi sequence IEC104 per asosiasi TCP. Gunakan state session baru yang tervalidasi independen.

sections.headingEn: Unknown in-flight breaker command at the switch
sections.headingId: Command breaker in-flight saat switch berstatus unknown
paragraphsEn: A command may reach the field device just before the active link drops, while ACTCON or fresh breaker feedback is lost. The correct outcome is **unknown**, not automatically success or failure.

After failover, the promoted owner must verify command authority and fresh independent feedback before allowing an operator to act. Automatic retransmission of a physical control solely because confirmation was not captured is unsafe.
paragraphsId: Command dapat mencapai perangkat lapangan tepat sebelum link aktif jatuh, sementara ACTCON atau feedback breaker baru hilang. Hasil yang benar adalah **unknown**, bukan otomatis sukses atau gagal.

Sesudah failover, owner baru perlu memverifikasi otoritas command serta feedback independen terbaru sebelum operator dapat bertindak. Retransmit otomatis kontrol fisik hanya karena konfirmasi tidak tercapture merupakan tindakan tidak aman.
bulletsEn: Record last TX before failure, confirmation boundaries and first RX on promoted link.
Reconcile actual field state separately from protocol ACKs.
bulletsId: Catat TX terakhir sebelum gangguan, batas confirmation dan RX pertama pada link promosi.
Rekonsiliasi state lapangan aktual terpisah dari ACK protokol.

lab.scenarioEn: TX command on A -> A lost -> no ACTCON captured -> B active -> status not yet read back.
lab.scenarioId: TX command pada A -> A hilang -> ACTCON tidak tertangkap -> B aktif -> status belum dibaca ulang.
stepsEn: The missing ACTCON is not proof that the command never reached the RTU.
A second command could cause a duplicate physical operation.
stepsId: ACTCON yang tidak tertangkap bukan bukti command tidak mencapai RTU.
Command kedua dapat menimbulkan aksi fisik duplikat.
lab.questionEn: May the master automatically retransmit the command on B?
lab.questionId: Bolehkah master otomatis mengirim ulang command di B?
lab.answerEn: No. Mark execution ambiguous and require state readback, permissions and operator-controlled recovery.
lab.answerId: Tidak. Tandai eksekusi ambigu dan wajibkan readback state, pemeriksaan izin serta recovery terkendali operator.

sections.headingEn: How to prove event continuity at a boundary
sections.headingId: Cara membuktikan kontinuitas event saat batas switch
paragraphsEn: Two links reporting the same event after a switch do not automatically represent two independent process events. Compare the last confirmed event before loss, source timestamp/identity, queue handling and new owner acknowledgment rules.

With only a tap on one duplex link, the opposite redundant link is unobserved. For physical A/B evidence, capture the required directions of both circuits or explicitly mark the unavailable path as not observed.
paragraphsId: Dua link melaporkan event sama setelah switch tidak otomatis mewakili dua peristiwa proses independen. Bandingkan event terakhir terkonfirmasi sebelum kehilangan, identitas/timestamp sumber, penanganan antrian dan aturan ACK owner baru.

Dengan tap hanya pada satu link duplex, link redundant lainnya tidak teramati. Untuk evidence fisik A/B, capture arah yang diperlukan dari kedua sirkuit atau tandai jalur yang tidak tersedia sebagai not observed.
bulletsEn: Correlate duplication only when source identity and event representation permit it.
Do not infer perfect exactly-once delivery between arbitrary vendor RTUs.
bulletsId: Korelasikan duplikasi hanya jika identitas sumber dan representasi event mendukungnya.
Jangan menganggap delivery exactly-once sempurna antar RTU vendor berbeda.

lab.scenarioEn: Event appears on A before loss; a visually identical event appears on B after switch.
lab.scenarioId: Event muncul pada A sebelum putus; event yang tampak identik muncul pada B setelah switch.
stepsEn: One hypothesis is RTU retransmission of an unacknowledged event.
Without source identity/ACK evidence, exact duplication remains unproven.
stepsId: Satu hipotesis adalah retransmit RTU atas event yang belum di-ACK.
Tanpa identitas sumber/evidence ACK, duplikasi persis belum terbukti.
lab.questionEn: Can the analyzer say 'two separate breaker operations'?
lab.questionId: Bolehkah analyzer menyatakan 'dua operasi breaker terpisah'?
lab.answerEn: No. Report potential retransmission or duplicate with stated confidence and preserve both raw captures.
lab.answerId: Tidak. Laporkan potensi retransmit atau duplikat beserta confidence-nya dan pertahankan kedua capture mentah.

chapters.summaryEn: Select approved profiles, security controls and commissioning evidence without inventing IEC mandates.
chapters.summaryId: Pilih profil, pengamanan dan bukti commissioning tanpa mengarang kewajiban IEC.
chapters.searchText: iec62351 firewall ip access ntp cyber security interoperability conformance

paragraphsEn: Read the exact IEC edition/amendment, selected companion options, Norwegian convention revision if applicable, vendor interoperability sheets and project deviations. Two devices advertising 'IEC104 supported' may still differ in Type IDs, controls, timers and multi-frontend authority.
Conformance tests should include decoded negative replies, invalid quality and boundary cases. Successful one-way data display is a useful test but not complete interoperable control proof.
paragraphsId: Baca edisi/amendemen IEC yang tepat, opsi companion, revisi konvensi Norwegia bila berlaku, interoperability sheet vendor dan deviasi proyek. Dua perangkat yang menyatakan 'IEC104 supported' bisa berbeda pada Type ID, kontrol, timer serta kewenangan multi-frontend.

Tes conformance harus mencakup respons negatif yang di-decode, quality invalid dan kasus batas. Tampilan data searah berhasil adalah tes berguna tetapi belum membuktikan interoperabilitas kontrol menyeluruh.
bulletsEn: Keep each product's declared supported object types and COTs.
Preserve exact negotiated lengths and sequence/timer configuration.
bulletsId: Simpan tipe objek dan COT yang didukung setiap perangkat.
Pertahankan panjang field serta konfigurasi sequence/timer yang disepakati.

sections.headingEn: Security is a separate engineering layer
paragraphsEn: Traditional IEC 101/103 serial and IEC 104 TCP deployments need project-appropriate isolation, access controls, logging and physical safety. IEC 104 TCP connectivity alone is not authentication or encryption. The IEC 62351 family addresses security aspects of power-system communication; its specific deployment requirements depend on the chosen architecture.

Do not recommend disabling firewalls to 'make IEC104 work'. Instead identify the communicating master and server endpoints, necessary allowed routes, permitted ports, authorization and monitoring. Log denied connections and unexpected originators.
paragraphsId: Deployment tradisional IEC 101/103 serial dan IEC 104 TCP memerlukan isolasi, kontrol akses, logging dan keselamatan fisik sesuai proyek. Koneksi TCP IEC 104 bukan autentikasi atau enkripsi dengan sendirinya. Keluarga IEC 62351 membahas aspek keamanan komunikasi sistem tenaga; syarat penerapannya bergantung arsitektur terpilih.

Jangan menyarankan mematikan firewall demi 'membuat IEC104 bekerja'. Identifikasi endpoint master/server, rute yang diizinkan, port yang diperlukan, otorisasi dan monitoring. Catat koneksi ditolak dan originator tidak dikenal.
bulletsEn: Capture expected master-to-RTU routes and accepted listener ports.
Document time source, event logging and recovery procedures.
Treat a security exception as a controlled change requiring review.
bulletsId: Catat rute master-ke-RTU dan listener port yang diizinkan.
Dokumentasikan sumber waktu, event logging dan prosedur pemulihan.
Perlakukan pengecualian keamanan sebagai perubahan terkendali yang harus ditinjau.

sections.headingEn: Claim only what the capture proves
paragraphsEn: Distinguish four outcomes: observed valid, observed but unverified, inferred and not observed. Missing physical tap directions or an incomplete timing window cannot support a categorical claim about all master/RTU messages.

A useful FAT result attaches raw bytes, decode settings, the intended interoperability case, actual state or lack of proof, and a recommended retest. No single vendor manual or handbook chapter replaces project-controlled acceptance criteria.
paragraphsId: Bedakan empat hasil: observed valid, observed but unverified, inferred dan not observed. Arah tap fisik yang tidak lengkap atau interval waktu capture pendek tidak dapat mendukung klaim pasti tentang semua pesan master/RTU.

Hasil FAT yang berguna melampirkan byte mentah, pengaturan decode, kasus interoperability yang diuji, state aktual atau bukti yang belum ada, serta retest yang disarankan. Manual vendor atau bab handbook saja tidak menggantikan kriteria penerimaan terkendali proyek.
bulletsEn: Never infer missing physical feedback from protocol acknowledgement alone.
Mark simulated tests separately from field device interoperability tests.
bulletsId: Jangan menyimpulkan feedback fisik dari ACK protokol saja.
Pisahkan tes simulasi dari tes interoperabilitas perangkat lapangan.

chapters.summaryEn: Commissioning recipes, healthy rhythms, negative tests and evidence-ready reports.
chapters.summaryId: Resep commissioning, ritme komunikasi sehat, tes negatif dan laporan dengan evidence.

paragraphsEn: Start with the family overview and architecture, then study one protocol's link/session lifecycle before looking at any hex dump. Follow with normal polling/GI, events and control confirmations. Finish by deliberately introducing a safe link fault into a controlled lab and observing its complete evidence timeline.

A learning exercise should be reproducible with synthetic or simulator data, not live control of electrical equipment. The aim is to build layer-by-layer confidence rather than memorize a table of bytes.
paragraphsId: Mulai dari peta keluarga IEC dan arsitektur, lalu pelajari siklus link/session satu protokol sebelum membaca hex dump. Lanjutkan dengan polling/GI normal, event serta confirmation command. Akhiri dengan gangguan link aman pada laboratorium terkontrol dan amati timeline evidence lengkap.
Latihan harus dapat diulang menggunakan data sintetis atau simulator, bukan kontrol peralatan listrik bertegangan. Tujuannya membangun pemahaman tiap lapisan, bukan menghafal tabel byte.
bulletsEn: IEC 101: link/FCB, Class 2 background, ACD-triggered Class 1, GI, event confirmation.
IEC 103: relay FUN/INF, time-tagged event, generic services and gateway mapping.
IEC 104: TCP, STARTDT, I/S/U, GI vs spontaneous events, sequence and takeover.
NUC/redundancy: active ownership, standby supervision, switchover and post-switch freshness.
bulletsId: IEC 101: link/FCB, Class 2 latar belakang, Class 1 karena ACD, GI, konfirmasi event.
IEC 103: FUN/INF relay, event bertimestamp, generic services dan mapping gateway.
IEC 104: TCP, STARTDT, I/S/U, GI vs event spontan, sequence dan takeover.
NUC/redundansi: ownership active, supervisi standby, switchover dan freshness sesudah switch.

paragraphsEn: For each scenario document configuration, expected request, observed response, timestamp/source, decode confidence, pass/fail or not-proven, and attached raw frame reference. Test both positive and negative scenarios. Do not confuse a simulator pass with physical multi-vendor interoperability.

A healthy exchange should show one connected chain: a real request on the expected source, a matching response with valid link/APCI context, supported ASDU, correct mapped point quality and the expected transaction conclusion.
paragraphsId: Untuk setiap skenario catat konfigurasi, request yang diharapkan, respons teramati, timestamp/sumber, confidence decode, pass/fail atau not-proven, serta referensi frame mentah. Uji skenario positif dan negatif. Simulator lulus bukan bukti interoperabilitas fisik multi-vendor.

Pertukaran yang sehat harus menunjukkan rantai: request nyata pada sumber yang benar, respons cocok dengan konteks link/APCI valid, ASDU didukung, quality point mapping tepat dan hasil transaksi sesuai.
bulletsEn: Positive: startup, GI completion, idle/background scans, event/change, benign command in simulator.
Negative: wrong link address, wrong CA, DFC busy, malformed frame, missing ACTCON, active link failure.
Redundancy: stale application image, event at switch boundary, unstable standby and in-flight command.
Record whether a verdict is observed, correlated, inferred or not observed.
bulletsId: Positif: startup, GI selesai, scan latar belakang, event/perubahan dan command aman pada simulator.
Negatif: link address salah, CA salah, DFC busy, frame rusak, ACTCON hilang, link aktif gagal.
Redundansi: application image stale, event tepat saat switch, standby labil dan command in-flight.
Catat apakah verdict berupa observed, correlated, inferred atau not observed.

paragraphsEn: Use the same questions in ArSee's Help Center and website Wiki: What was sent? What was received on which link? Was the frame valid? What does the selected protocol/profile say the response means? What physical or application step is still unproven?

If nothing is received, check transport and link addressing before object mapping. If traffic flows but no Values appear, check ASDU COT/CA/IOA or FUN/INF and profile widths. If a command appears successful without feedback, report application confirmation separately from observed field state.
paragraphsId: Gunakan pertanyaan sama di Help Center ArSee dan Wiki: Apa yang dikirim? Apa yang diterima di link mana? Apakah frame valid? Apa arti respons menurut protokol/profil terpilih? Langkah fisik atau aplikasi apa yang belum terbukti?

Jika RX kosong, cek transport dan link address sebelum mapping. Jika traffic ada tapi Values kosong, cek COT/CA/IOA atau FUN/INF dan panjang field. Jika command tampak sukses tanpa feedback, laporkan konfirmasi aplikasi terpisah dari kondisi lapangan yang teramati.
bulletsEn: Attach evidence from before, during and after the anomaly.
Show raw bytes plus decoded protocol fields and uncertainty.
Use real site-approved manuals/interop lists for final conformance judgment.
bulletsId: Lampirkan evidence sebelum, selama dan sesudah anomali.
Tampilkan byte mentah serta field hasil decode berikut ketidakpastian.
Gunakan manual/interoperability list yang disahkan site untuk keputusan conformance.

sections.headingEn: Field checklist: master polls but the RTU looks silent
sections.headingId: Checklist lapangan: master polling tetapi RTU diam
paragraphsEn: Observe TX frame integrity, serial direction and station link address; only then inspect RX. A pulsing TX LED does not prove the RTU decoded a valid link request. If RX exists but Values stays empty, verify ASDU Type/COT/CA/IOA or FUN/INF before changing arbitrary serial timers.

When only part of a GI arrives, do not assume a fixed point count from the protocol itself. Compare requested group, device mapping, data type, buffer limits, time budget, and termination evidence. At low baud rates, an overloaded Class 1 queue may delay background or GI progression.
paragraphsId: Amati integritas frame TX, arah serial dan link address stasiun; baru setelah itu periksa RX. LED TX berkedip tidak membuktikan RTU berhasil mendecode request link valid. Jika RX ada tetapi Values kosong, cek Type/COT/CA/IOA atau FUN/INF sebelum mengubah timer serial sembarang.

Ketika GI hanya sebagian, jangan menganggap protokol menentukan jumlah point tetap. Bandingkan grup yang diminta, mapping perangkat, tipe data, batas buffer, waktu yang tersedia dan bukti terminasi. Pada baud rendah, antrian Class 1 yang padat dapat menunda background atau GI.
bulletsEn: Prove TX and RX bytes with valid link checksum or APCI sequence.
Separate no-data from no-response and DFC busy.
Document unknown/partial GI status honestly in the FAT report.
bulletsId: Buktikan byte TX dan RX dengan checksum link atau sequence APCI valid.
Pisahkan no-data dari no-response dan DFC busy.
Dokumentasikan status GI unknown/partial secara jelas dalam laporan FAT.
